title: Final ML Course Project: Classification & Regression Mastery
summary: A course project applying classic machine learning algorithms to classification and regression tasks, covering data preparation, feature selection, and model evaluation. It augments the training data using SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, fitting it on the dataframe via SingleTableMetadata and sampling 5000 synthetic rows to expand the dataset.
evidence: Maor_Nave_313603391_EX3_2_ML_Final.py:332-338 uses SingleTableMetadata + GaussianCopulaSynthesizer.fit/sample(num_rows=5000) to generate synthetic data for augmentation.
